benign_signal_categories.name: Twilio Client Intermittent Errors
benign_signal_categories.interpretation: Twilio infrastructure intermittent issues. Not caused by candidate or exam platform. Expected to auto-recover on retry.

benign_signal_categories.name: Event Processing & Async Handler Errors
benign_signal_categories.interpretation: Background event processing encountered a transient error. Platform continues operating. No session data loss.

benign_signal_categories.name: Container/Infrastructure One-Time Initialization
benign_signal_categories.interpretation: One-time infrastructure setup error during startup. Service continues operation. No session impact.

benign_signal_categories.name: Exception Message in Response (By Design)
benign_signal_categories.interpretation: API error response includes exception reason field. This is intentional design for client error reporting. Domain exceptions are scoped (not system-level leakage).

benign_signal_categories.name: Console.WriteLine in Metrics/Debug Listeners
benign_signal_categories.interpretation: Diagnostic metrics listener emitting to console. Expected in non-production or debug-instrumented paths. Not user-visible.

benign_signal_categories.name: Generic Catch Blocks in Event Handlers
benign_signal_categories.interpretation: Event handler or background processor catches broad exceptions. Expected pattern for resilience in async flows. No data loss if handler exits gracefully.

benign_signal_categories.name: Hardcoded Test Credentials
benign_signal_categories.interpretation: Test file contains dummy connection strings. Not production credentials. Security risk is test-environment only.

benign_signal_categories.name: Payload Serialization for Logging/Audit
benign_signal_categories.interpretation: JSON serialization of DTOs for logging/audit purposes. Expected pattern. Safe if limited to data-transfer objects (not full domain objects with secrets).

benign_signal_categories.name: Missing Correlation ID in Background Work
indicators: No correlation ID in async handler
benign_signal_categories.interpretation: Background worker or deferred handler lacks correlation ID from incoming request. Expected in async flows without propagation. Not mission-critical for exam integrity.

benign_signal_categories.name: Dynamic Log Level Checks & Optimizations
benign_signal_categories.interpretation: Performance optimization: guard expensive computations behind log-level checks. Valid pattern.

benign_signal_categories.name: ApplicationBlock EventType ≠ Exam Failure
benign_signal_categories.interpretation: ApplicationBlock is a valid event type (often deny-list enforcement or intentional block). Not inherently a failure. Consult deny-list context to interpret.

benign_signal_categories.name: GingerWebs 'not terminate' ≠ Failure
benign_signal_categories.interpretation: GingerWebs returned 'not terminate' decision. This is a LEGITIMATE decision, not a failure. Exam continues per GW policy.

cross_cutting_patterns.reason: Stack trace reset in client exception handling. Observable in logs but not mission-critical.
cross_cutting_patterns.action: Acknowledge but do not interpret as exam failure

cross_cutting_patterns.reason: Debug/diagnostic output. Not user-visible. Expected in non-prod contexts.
cross_cutting_patterns.action: Ignore unless paired with actual service failure

cross_cutting_patterns.reason: Expected for caching/logging infrastructure objects. Safe if DTO-scoped.
cross_cutting_patterns.action: Acknowledge but flag only if serializing secrets or PII

cross_cutting_patterns.reason: Resilience pattern for async/distributed scenarios. Expected.
cross_cutting_patterns.action: Acknowledge. Only escalate if handler swallowed critical operation result

decision_tree.if_see_twilio_error: → likely benign (Twilio infra), check if exam session continued
decision_tree.if_see_event_processor_error: → likely benign (background async), check if session data persisted
decision_tree.if_see_console_writeline: → check context: KestrelMetrics = benign; elsewhere = investigate
decision_tree.if_see_generic_catch: → check context: event handler = benign; critical path = investigate
decision_tree.if_see_gw_not_terminate: → legitimate GW decision, NOT a failure
